primitive_lift.operation: if N^2 divides Q, replace the first nonzero xi by xi-N
primitive_lift.residue_invariant: xi-N is congruent to xi modulo N
primitive_lift.quotient_change: Q/N changes by -2*ai*xi modulo N and is nonzero because N is odd and ai,xi are nonzero modulo N
primitive_lift.ideal_invariant: gamma in O0/N*O0 and therefore gamma*beta modulo N are unchanged
primitive_lift.implementation_schedule: evaluate and verify both divisibility predicates for every candidate, then mask-select the signed lift

beta_randomization.local_algebra: B_(p,infinity) splits at N!=p, so O0/N*O0 is M2(F_N)
beta_randomization.gamma_class: a nonzero norm-zero quaternion is a rank-one matrix
beta_randomization.beta_class: a nonzero-norm quaternion is an element of GL2(F_N)
beta_randomization.action: right multiplication by uniform GL2(F_N) is transitive with equal stabilizers on the N+1 row lines
beta_randomization.left_ideal: M2(F_N)*(gamma*beta) is determined by that row line
beta_randomization.conclusion: conditional on exact-uniform sampler success, the output left ideal is exactly uniform among the N+1 ideals of norm N, independently of the selected-gamma distribution

wide_reduction_bound.real_sampler_failure: exact-model failure plus joint input distance, strictly less than 2^-128
